The theorems.

  1. wilsons_theorem_and_its_converse — ((List.range' 2 18).all (fun p => ¬ isPrime p || Sequences.fact (p - 1) % p == p - 1)) ∧ ((List.range' 5 15).all (fun n => isPrime n || Sequences.fact (n - 1) % n == 0)) record
  2. every_number_is_a_sum_of_four_squares — (List.range 60).all isSumOfFour ∧ isSumOfThree 7 = false ∧ isSumOfFour 7 = true record
  3. the_cantor_pairing_is_injective_and_covers_an_initial_segment — block.eraseDups.length = 64 ∧ ((List.range 36).all (fun n => block.contains n)) record
  4. repunit_divisibility_by_three_and_seven — ((List.range' 1 18).all (fun n => (repunit n % 3 == 0) == (n % 3 == 0))) ∧ ((List.range' 1 18).all (fun n => (repunit n % 7 == 0) == (n % 6 == 0))) record
  5. the_euler_characteristic_of_a_genus_g_surface — ((List.range 12).all (fun g => chi g + 2 * (g : Int) == 2)) ∧ chi 0 = 2 ∧ chi 1 = 0 ∧ chi 2 = -2 record
  6. odd_divisor_count_iff_perfect_square — (List.range' 1 120).all (fun n => ((divisors n).length % 2 == 1) == isSquare n) record
  7. havel_hakimi_decides_graphical_sequences — hh 12 [3, 3, 3, 3] = true ∧ hh 12 [2, 2, 2] = true ∧ hh 12 [3, 3, 1, 1] = false ∧ hh 12 [4, 1, 1, 1, 1] = true ∧ hh 12 [5, 1, 1, 1, 1] = false record
